profile_text.body:
GE HealthCare Technologies Inc. is a public company traded as GEHC and headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. Its own site describes it as a provider of digital infrastructure, data analytics and decision support tools that help in the diagnosis, treatment and monitoring of patients. The company says it builds integrated solutions aimed at the healthcare industry's challenges, and describes the future of healthcare as precise, personal and connected.

On AI, the site states that the company has over 130 years of delivering innovative solutions and that it tops the FDA's list of AI-enabled medical devices. It says its work is intended to transform how hospitals and healthcare systems operate and to help clinicians make therapies more accurate and effective. No individual products or MCP servers are tracked in the record.

The company's SEC filing identifier is 0001932393. Its litigation exposure is recorded in Illinois, with a count of 374.
